title: Password Encryption
description: Encrypt every plaintext password and learn to read the hash types in the config.
scenario: Encrypt every plaintext password and learn to read the hash types in the config.

concepts.title: service password-encryption
concepts.body: This global command encrypts all plaintext passwords in the config (line passwords, usernames) using weak Type 7 — reversible, but hides them from casual viewing.

concepts.title: Hash Types: 7 vs 5
concepts.body: Type 7 (password 7 ...) is weak and reversible. Type 5 (secret 5 ...) is a real MD5 hash. Always prefer enable secret over enable password.

concepts.title: Verifying
concepts.body: Run "show running-config" and check the number after the keyword: 7 = weak reversible, 5 = MD5 hash. Line passwords now show as Type 7 after the service command.
concepts.code:
SW1# show running-config
 line console 0
  password 7 08314F5D
